summary.en: Chinese warships and coast guard vessels continued to monitor a U.S. warship near a disputed shoal while also operating near the Pratas Islands and Scarborough Shoal, prompting the Philippines to summon China’s ambassador over threatening remarks. Vice Admiral Rommel Supangan assumed command of the Philippine Coast Guard and led a rescue of four people, including a child, on Hagonoy Island, Surigao del Sur. Taiwan’s coast guard and maritime forces repelled sixteen mainland Chinese ships near the Pratas Islands. The United States and the Philippines conducted their sixteenth bilateral maritime exercise in the West Philippine Sea. There were 176 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Kinesiske krigsskip og kystvaktskip fortsatte å overvåke et amerikansk krigsskip nær et omstridt skjær samtidig som de opererte nær Pratasøyene og Scarborough-skjæret, noe som førte til at Filippinene innkalt Kinas ambassadør på grunn av truende bemerkninger. Viceadmiral Rommel Supangan overtok kommandoen for Filippinenes kystvakt og ledet en redningsaksjon for fire personer, inkludert et barn, på Hagonoy-øya i Surigao del Sur. Taiwans kystvakt og maritime styrker avverget seksten kinesiske skip nær Pratasøyene. USA og Filippinene gjennomførte sin sekstende bilaterale maritime øvelse i Vestfilippinske hav. Det var 176 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
